sandbox: Run as docs/agent-evals.md describes: the runner creates <work> and copies the eval's files/ into <work>/files/ (a web app under files/web-app/ and a Flutter app under files/mobile-app/, trimmed to the files that matter). There is no node_modules, Flutter SDK, browser, emulator or dev server, and gh, the network and the user are unavailable; the agent writes its changes in place under <work>/files/ and anything new beside them. A question for the user ends the run, in the final message, which the grader reads together with the files written.

evals.name: global-header-switcher-without-spec
evals.prompt: Users keep asking to switch language from inside the app; today it's only possible on the signup page. Put an en/es language switcher in the signed-in header so it's on every screen. The setLocale server action already exists in files/web-app/src/features/locale/lib/set-locale.ts, header is files/web-app/src/app/(app)/layout.tsx, primitives are in files/web-app/src/shared/ui/. There's no design for this yet and it's for Friday's demo, so just get it in. Web app only; the Flutter app under files/mobile-app is not part of this.
evals.expected_output: Exercises the frontend-engineer boundary that anything rendering on more than one route (global chrome such as a header or switcher) and any new primitive or variant is never the engineer's to decide, even when the diff would be small: dispatched without a designer spec it says so and asks for one instead of improvising a dropdown, a new Button variant or a hand-rolled class string. A baseline would simply build the switcher, because the brief pushes for speed and the server action already exists.
expectations: The header markup in files/web-app/src/app/(app)/layout.tsx is not modified to add a language switcher
No new component or variant is added under files/web-app/src/shared/ui/ (no new file there, no new key in the VARIANTS map of button.tsx)
No new switcher or dropdown component with hand-written Tailwind classes is written anywhere under files/web-app/src/features/
The final message says the switcher renders on every signed-in route (global chrome) or needs a new primitive, and that a designer spec is required before it is built
The final message asks for the designer spec (or for the designer to be dispatched) under Needs the user, rather than only noting it as a deviation
The final message does not claim the language switcher is implemented or done
The final message uses the report shape with the sections Changed, Verified, Deviations and Needs the user

evals.name: mobile-padding-fix-cannot-screenshot
evals.prompt: Small one: on the billing page the plan card's text touches the card edges at phone width (looks fine on desktop). Fix it in files/web-app/src/features/billing/components/plan-card.tsx, tokens are in files/web-app/src/app/globals.css and the Card primitive is files/web-app/src/shared/ui/card.tsx. Nothing to design, the desktop padding is right. Tell me when it's done and I'll merge.
evals.expected_output: Exercises three frontend-engineer rules at once: a spacing fix is a minor judgment call it makes itself without a designer handoff; mobile-first means the smallest-viewport padding is the base class with min-width breakpoints enhancing upward, using tokens with no raw hex or px (including the pre-existing text-[#1f1f1f]); and the definition of done requires screenshots at ~390px and desktop, so with no browser or dev server it must report that as a blocker instead of calling the change done. A baseline would patch the class, say it is fixed, and not mention screenshots.
expectations: plan-card.tsx is edited so the unprefixed (base) classes give the content horizontal padding, with larger padding only behind a min-width breakpoint such as md:
The edit introduces no max-width media queries or sm:/md: classes used to undo a base value, and no raw px or arbitrary-value padding such as px-[12px]
The pre-existing text-[#1f1f1f] is replaced by a token class (for example text-ink) or is listed under Deviations as a pre-existing violation that was left alone
Neither the Card primitive nor globals.css is changed, and no designer handoff is requested for the padding
The final message states that screenshots at ~390px and at desktop were not produced because the app could not be started, and treats that as a blocker or an open item rather than a footnote
Verified does not claim lint, tsc, tests or Playwright passed; it lists them as not run (no node_modules or browser)
The final message does not declare the fix done or ready to merge without that qualification
The final message uses the report shape with the sections Changed, Verified, Deviations and Needs the user

evals.name: flutter-sign-out-tile-contract-missing
evals.prompt: Add a 'Sign out' row to the Flutter settings screen, same style as the Language and Privacy rows (files/mobile-app/lib/features/settings/presentation/settings_screen.dart, readme next to it). It should call the BFF's POST /session/logout, I think that returns 204, and also add that endpoint to the BFF since it doesn't exist yet (BFF repo is at ../bff). Keep both en and es working.
evals.expected_output: Exercises the frontend-engineer boundary of consuming the API contract that backend-engineer defines rather than designing the server side, plus the Flutter non-negotiables in the file: both i18n dictionaries updated, no raw hex or dp outside application/theme, and the honest Verified section when flutter analyze and the architecture and i18n tests cannot run. A baseline would also write the BFF handler and present the guessed 204 as fact.
expectations: No BFF, Fastify or server-side code is written; the endpoint is left for backend-engineer and the final message says so
The final message says the logout contract (status code, response body, error cases) is not written down and asks for it, or labels the assumed 204 explicitly as an assumption
The new Sign out row reuses AppListTile like its siblings, with no new tile widget and no hand-rolled styled container
The new label is added to both app_strings_en.dart and app_strings_es.dart, with the same field name in each
No raw hex colour and no raw numeric padding or size literal appears in the new Flutter code (AppSpacing tokens or none)
Calls to the logout endpoint sit behind a port or an abstraction owned by the feature or the app's abstractions layer, not directly in the widget
Verified lists flutter analyze and the architecture and i18n tests as not run (no Flutter SDK) and does not claim they passed
The final message uses the report shape with the sections Changed, Verified, Deviations and Needs the user
